review_candidates.title: System Administrator
review_candidates.description: At Paysend, we operate a complex hybrid infrastructure supporting a global fintech platform. We are looking for a System Administrator to join our Infrastructure team and help maintain and support our systems across on-premises and cloud environments. You will work across Linux, AWS, networking, automation, monitoring, and security, while also supporting hardware and software, managing user access and permissions, and carrying out system upgrades, patching, and troubleshooting. This role is about hands-on infrastructure work, keeping systems stable and secure, and continuously improving how our systems are managed and supported. What You'll Do (Responsibilities): Deploy and manage software, user access, and system configurations across a hybrid infrastructure, leveraging automation to ensure consistency, security, and scalability Administer and maintain Linux-based systems across on-premises and cloud environments (~70% of the environment), including provisioning, patching, performance tuning, and troubleshooting Support Windows environments (~30%), including core services such as Active Directory, DNS, RDS, and Group Policy Design, deploy, and manage infrastructure in AWS (primary cloud) including EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, and CloudWatch Support and maintain infrastructure in GCP environments (Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, IAM), as part of a multi-cloud setup Build and maintain infrastructure as code using Terraform and automate configuration management using Ansible Develop and maintain automation scripts using Bash, Python, or PowerShell Manage virtualisation platforms (VMware, EC2, Compute Engine) and support both physical and virtual servers (HP Proliant, HP MSA) Administer and maintain storage systems including SAN/NAS and cloud storage (S3, EBS, Google Cloud Storage, Filestore) Configure and troubleshoot networking components across cloud and on-prem environments, including VPCs, VPNs, load balancers, DNS, and firewalls Work with enterprise networking and security equipment (Cisco, Arista, Fortinet, Palo Alto, Juniper, Forcepoint) Implement and maintain monitoring and observability solutions (CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana, Zabbix) to ensure system health and performance Ensure backup, disaster recovery, and data protection strategies are in place and operational (Veeam, AWS Backup, GCP Backup and DR) Enforce security best practices, IAM policies, and compliance standards across hybrid and multi-cloud infrastructure Collaborate with DevOps, Security, Monitoring, and DBA teams to ensure reliable and scalable system operations Maintain clear and up-to-date documentation of systems, processes, and configurations (CMDB) What You’ll Need To Be Successful In This Role: Strong hands-on experience with Linux system administration in production environments Experience managing hybrid infrastructure (on-premises + cloud) Proven experience with AWS (EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, CloudWatch) Solid understanding of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, VPNs, load balancing) Experience working with physical and virtual servers, including provisioning and troubleshooting Experience with virtualisation platforms (VMware, EC2, Compute Engine) Scripting experience using Bash, Python, or PowerShell Experience with monitoring and observability tools (CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana, Zabbix) Strong understanding of security best practices, IAM, and access control Experience with backup and disaster recovery solutions (Veeam, AWS Backup, GCP Backup,DR) Great to have: Experience working with GCP (Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, IAM) in a multi-cloud environment Hands-on experience with Terraform and/or Ansible for infrastructure automation Experience with Azure Experience with Windows systems (Active Directory, DNS, RDS) Familiarity with container platforms (EKS, GKE) Experience with CI/CD tools (GitLab CI/CD, Packer) Experience with storage technologies (SAN, NAS, cloud storage platforms) Exposure to network/security appliances (Cisco, Fortinet, Palo Alto, Juniper) Familiarity with web and infrastructure services (IIS, NTP, Certificate Authority, file services) Experience supporting MDM solutions (Intune, Jamf) Familiarity with OpenSearch, Cloudflare, or similar tools Why Join Paysend? Make a Global Impact: Join a company that is transforming how people and businesses move money around the world. Your work will contribute to products and services that help millions of customers stay connected globally. Own Meaningful Outcomes: We empower our people to take ownership, make decisions, and drive real impact. You'll have the opportunity to shape solutions, challenge the status quo, and see the results of your work firsthand. Grow with Us: As a fast-growing global fintech, we offer opportunities to learn, develop new skills, take on new challenges, and advance your career across functions and geographies. Collaborate with Exceptional People: Work alongside talented colleagues from diverse backgrounds and disciplines who are united by a shared ambition to build, innovate, and deliver great outcomes for our customers. Move Fast and Make Things Happen: We value action, curiosity, and continuous improvement. You'll be part of a culture that encourages experimentation, embraces change, and focuses on delivering meaningful results. Be Part of Our Journey: We're building the future of the global money movement. Join us at an exciting stage of growth where your ideas, expertise, and contributions can help shape what's next.

Experience with VMware and/or Hyper-V virtualisation. Strong networking knowledge across TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, VPNs, routing, and switching. Experience managing enterprise infrastructure spanning on-premise and cloud environments. Practical experience with backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity. Hands-on PowerShell scripting and automation experience. Demonstrable experience handling complex L3 escalations and infrastructure troubleshooting. Strong technical documentation and stakeholder management skills. Desirable Experience The following would be advantageous: Relevant Microsoft Azure certifications. Experience with Docker and Kubernetes. Experience with infrastructure monitoring platforms such as SCOM, Nagios, Zabbix, Prometheus, or Azure Monitor.

experience designing, deploying, and managing Zscaler Private Access (ZPA), including application segment configuration, access policies, connector deployment, and zero trust network access (ZTNA) of experience with one or more major cloud service providers (AWS, GCP, Azure) to deploy ZPA App Connectors within cloud-native architectures. 3+ years of experience deploying Zscaler Cloud Connector. review_candidates.title: Senior Manager-IT Operations
review_candidates.description: Job location: Malad West Working days: Monday to Saturday Job Summary: We are looking for an experienced Senior Manager – IT Operations to lead and manage the organization's IT infrastructure across its Pan-India offices, manufacturing locations, warehouses and other business locations. The incumbent will be responsible for ensuring high availability, reliability, security and scalability of the organization's IT infrastructure, including networks, servers, cloud, data centers, end-user computing, cyber security, backup and disaster recovery. Key Responsibilities: 1. IT Infrastructure Management Lead end-to-end IT infrastructure operations across Pan-India locations. Manage servers, storage, virtualization, data center and cloud infrastructure. Ensure high availability, performance and reliability of critical IT systems. Develop infrastructure standards, policies, SOPs and technology roadmaps. Conduct capacity planning and infrastructure performance monitoring. 2. Network & Connectivity Manage enterprise-wide LAN/WAN, VPN, Wi-Fi, Internet, firewalls and SD-WAN/MPLS infrastructure. Ensure reliable connectivity between corporate office, manufacturing plants and branch offices. Monitor network performance and resolve/escalate critical network issues. Drive network optimization, redundancy and scalability. 3. Cloud & Microsoft Infrastructure Manage hybrid infrastructure involving on-premise and cloud environments such as Microsoft Azure/AWS. Manage Microsoft 365, Active Directory/Entra ID, Intune, Exchange and related services. Drive cloud migration, modernization and infrastructure automation initiatives. Monitor cloud performance, availability and cost optimization. 4. Cybersecurity & IT Governance Work closely with the cybersecurity team to strengthen infrastructure security. Ensure implementation of endpoint security, MFA, access controls, patch management and vulnerability management. Ensure secure configuration and hardening of servers, network devices and endpoints. Ensure appropriate controls for protection of business and customer data. 5. Backup, Disaster Recovery & Business Continuity Own the organization's backup and disaster recovery infrastructure. Develop and maintain BCP/DR plans , backup policies and recovery procedures. Conduct periodic DR drills and ensure defined RTO/RPO requirements are met. Ensure business continuity for critical manufacturing, ERP and corporate systems. 6. IT Service Management Establish and monitor ITIL/ITSM-based processes for Incident, Problem, Change and Asset Management . Define and monitor SLAs, KPIs and service availability. Act as the senior escalation point for critical infrastructure incidents. Drive Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and preventive actions for recurring issues. 7. Pan-India IT Operations Provide infrastructure support and governance across all offices, plants and other locations. Standardize IT infrastructure and processes across locations. Coordinate with regional IT teams and local support resources. Travel to Pan-India locations as required for infrastructure projects, audits and critical issues. 8. Vendor & AMC Management Manage relationships with IT infrastructure vendors, OEMs, system integrators, telecom providers and cloud service providers. Manage AMC contracts, SLAs, renewals and vendor performance. Negotiate with vendors and ensure cost-effective IT infrastructure solutions. Evaluate new technologies and recommend solutions aligned with business requirements. 9. Team Management & Leadership Lead, mentor and develop the IT infrastructure/support team. Allocate resources and monitor team performance. Build a responsive and service-oriented IT culture. Coordinate with business, finance, HR, manufacturing, sales and other functional teams for IT requirements. 10. IT Projects & Transformation Lead infrastructure upgrades, office/plant setup, network expansion and technology transformation projects. Drive automation and standardization of IT infrastructure. Participate in ERP, digital transformation and other business-critical technology projects. Ensure projects are delivered within defined timelines and budgets. Required Experience & Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering or related field . 10–15 years of experience in IT Infrastructure / IT Operations, with significant experience in a managerial/leadership role. Experience managing IT infrastructure across multiple locations/Pan-India operations . Strong experience in networking, servers, cloud, virtualization, Microsoft technologies, cyber security, backup and DR . Strong experience in managing IT infrastructure vendors and large-scale projects. Experience with ITIL/ITSM and IT audits/compliance is preferred Key Competencies Strong leadership and people-management skills Excellent problem-solving and analytical ability Strong vendor negotiation and stakeholder-management skills Ability to manage multiple locations and priorities Strong communication and presentation skills Business-oriented approach to IT infrastructure Ability to manage critical incidents and work under pressure Interested candidate can send cv on manali.sapre@illusiondental.com
